overviewParagraphs: Ba Na Hills Golf Club, set at the foot of the Ba Na Mountains in Da Nang, Vietnam, is a multi-award-winning championship layout designed by former World No. 1 Luke Donald. As the signature debut for Donald, the course offers a unique parkland experience that contrasts with the region's typical coastal links.

The layout winds through diverse terrain, from valley floors to dramatic hillside peaks, featuring significant elevation changes and natural water hazards. One of its standout features is the state-of-the-art LED lighting system, making it the premier destination for night golf in Vietnam.

Managed by IMG, the club maintains world-class standards, utilizing SeaIsle Paspalum grass to ensure a premium playing surface year-round. Whether playing under the tropical sun or the glow of stadium lights, Ba Na Hills provides an unforgettable technical test.

curatorBriefHtml: Ba Na Hills Golf Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Da Nang, Vietnam, crafted by Luke Donald / IMG (2016) and stretching to 7,858 Yards across a parkland environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its turf quality & greens conditioning (SeaIsle Paspalum • Stimp 10.5+) and strategic routing & elevation challenge (Luke Donald / IMG Mountain Design).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Ba Na Hills Golf Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie knowledge & line reading (High altitude & mountain slope expertise), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Da Nang golf tour by AGS, Ba Na Hills Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by Luke Donald / IMG that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: Ba Na Hills is the quintessential mountain championship layout in Southeast Asia. Luke Donald's tactical routing rewards disciplined club selection from dramatic elevated tees, while the comprehensive floodlighting creates an unmatched evening tournament atmosphere. An essential anchor round for any Da Nang golf tour.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Ba Na Hills Golf Club?
faqs.a: Ba Na Hills Golf Club in Da Nang, Vietnam is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Luke Donald / IMG (opened 2016), measuring 7,858 Yards within a parkland setting. It is particularly noted for turf quality & greens conditioning (SeaIsle Paspalum • Stimp 10.5+).

Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie knowledge & line reading (High altitude & mountain slope expertise)), and private VIP transfers from your Da Nang hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Ba Na Hills Golf Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Ba Na Hills Golf Club's strategic routing & elevation challenge (Luke Donald / IMG Mountain Design) alongside turf quality & greens conditioning (SeaIsle Paspalum • Stimp 10.5+). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.a: February through September is the prime season for Ba Na Hills Golf Club.
